newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Jan manufacturing up 7.0 pct year-on-year.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Jan manufacturing up 7.0 pct year-on-year.

text.p: The sales value of Malaysian manufacturing sector's output in January rose by 7.0 percent to 15.45 billion ringgit over the same period last year, the Statistics Department said on Wednesday.
However, the output was 1.3 percent lower than in December 1996, the department was quoted as saying by the national news agency Bernama.
The department's figures were based on a survey of 58 of the 137 manufacturing industries, it said.
It said 30 industries contributed 89.9 percent of the total sales value in January.

The department said semi-conductors recorded the most significant percentage increase of 80.3 percent during the month, followed by fuel oil (up 61.2 percent), iron and steel bars (up 51.6 percent) and passenger cars (up 24.6 percent).
